verdict.rationale: Smart Capture Link is documented as a low-/no-code hosted link that can verify individuals 'with or without engineering effort,' and Entrust hosts the verification journey and sends the link to customers, which matches the core of a no-engineering one-off verification link. However, the quick-start flow still shows applicant/workflow-run creation happening via backend API calls with tokens, implying some setup may still need engineering, and there is no mention of QR code generation or an ops-facing self-serve dashboard to send links without any backend involvement. missing for 10: explicit QR code support, a documented self-serve dashboard flow for ops to generate/send links without any API/backend step, and independent confirmation of pure no-code usage.
